prompt: A simple 2D cross-section diagram of a solid block submerged in a liquid inside an insulated container. Object relations: The container is a simple open-topped rectangular tank with a thick, diagonally-hatched outer wall representing insulation. The liquid fills the lower portion of the container. A simple rectangular solid block rests flat on the bottom of the container, fully submerged in the liquid. Label anchors: Label 'liquid' placed outside the container to the top-left; a single straight leader line enters the container and terminates on an empty patch of liquid above the block. It must not point at the block, the surface line, or the container walls. Label 'solid block' placed outside the container to the bottom-left; leader line points to the outline of the block. Label 'insulated container' placed outside to the right; leader line points to the hatched wall of the container. Style: Professional monochrome admissions-test diagram. Pure white background #FFFFFF. Crisp black vector-like line art. Times New Roman-like serif typography. Minimalist, no clutter. Negative constraints: No grey wash, gradient, or paper texture. No extra labels, no temperature values, no heat flow arrows, no 3D perspective, no photorealism, no overlapping lines.
negative_prompt: Pure white background only; no grey paper, gradient, or texture. No extra labels. No overlap. No sans-serif fonts. No decorative shading. No photorealism. No colour unless explicitly requested. No exact answer-bearing measurements. No clutter. No malformed symbols. Do not place objects in the wrong support/location relationship. No medium label pointing at objects inside the medium. No fluid label terminating on a sphere, wall, or meniscus. No unrequested arrows, force labels, field symbols, construction arcs, or explanatory overlays. No heat flow arrows. No temperature values.

must_show_relations: solid block must be fully submerged in the liquid
solid block must rest on the bottom of the container
container must have a visibly thick or hatched wall to indicate insulation
relative_size_constraints: container must be large enough to clearly show empty liquid space above and around the block

hard_constraints: background must be pure white #FFFFFF with no grey fill or gradient
label liquid: text outside container; leader ends on empty liquid, not on the block or walls
no unrequested arrows, heat flow indicators, or temperature labels
